title: An S3 Lifecycle rule over one year
claim: A lifecycle rule moves an object to colder storage classes as it gets older, and then deletes it.
alt: A timeline of object age with ticks at day 0, day 30, day 90 and day 365. The object is in S3 Standard from day 0 to day 30, in S3 Standard-IA from day 30 to day 90, and in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval from day 90 to day 365. A second lane shows how often the object is read: often, then rarely, then almost never. At day 365 the object expires.
